    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

                            <!-- OC Layout Element Conent Template -->
							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><div class="department-container">
<div class="grid">
	<div class="col-xs-12 col-m-8">
		<h1 class="oc-page-title ">Office of Management and Budget</h1>
		
       <picture>
  <source media="(min-width: 992px)" srcset="/files/assets/county/v/1/government/administration/images/agencies-departments/omb-calculator_900.jpg?dimension=pageimagefullwidth&amp;w=1140">
  <source media="(min-width: 768px)" srcset="/files/assets/county/v/1/government/administration/images/agencies-departments/omb-calculator_900.jpg?dimension=pageimagefullwidth&amp;w=992">
  <source srcset="/files/assets/county/v/1/government/administration/images/agencies-departments/omb-calculator_900.jpg?dimension=pageimagefullwidth&amp;w=768">
  <img class="main-page-image full-width" src="/files/assets/county/v/1/government/administration/images/agencies-departments/omb-calculator_900.jpg?dimension=pageimagefullwidth&amp;w=1140" alt="Office of Management and Budget (OMB) " title="Office of Management and Budget (OMB) ">
</picture> 
	    <div class="wysiwyg-content body-content"><p>The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is a key department in Osceola County that helps with planning, implementing, and monitoring the County's annual budget. The budget includes how the County spends money on various programs and services, as well as how it raises money from taxes and fees.</p>
<p>OMB also oversees the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.osceola.org/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Special-Assessments" target="_self">Special Assessments</a>, which are charges for specific services or benefits that some residents or property owners receive.</p>
<p>OMB presents the budget and Five-Year Capital Improvement Plan each year.</p>
<h2>Functions of OMB</h2>
<div data-type="0" data-title-level="3" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">


</div>
<div class="accordion-list-container"><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-1" aria-controls="accord-1-1" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Agenda Items</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-1" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>OMB analyzes the budgetary impact of the items the Board of County Commissioners (BOCC) discusses and votes on in their meetings.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-2" aria-controls="accord-1-2" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Annual Budget</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-2" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>OMB prepares the annual budget for the entire County, which shows how much money the County expects to receive and spend in a fiscal year. OMB also presents the budget to the BOCC and the public for review and approval. <a href="https://osceolacofl.prelive.opencities.com/County/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Budget-Documents" target="_self">View the latest budget documents</a>.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-3" aria-controls="accord-1-3" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Budget Monitoring</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-3" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p><span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 1em;">OMB tracks the revenue actuals and expenditures of the County throughout the year and identifies any issues or adjustments that may be needed to keep the budget balanced and aligned with established policies and procedures, departmental guidelines, and statutory requirements.</span></p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-4" aria-controls="accord-1-4" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Budget Adjustments</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-4" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p><span style="font-size: 1em; font-family: inherit;">OMB processes any changes to the budget that may occur during the year, such as transfers, supplements, or amendments. These changes may be authorized by the BOCC or the Budget Officer, depending on the type and amount of adjustment. OMB follows the state laws and County policies that govern how the budget can be adjusted.</span></p>
<p><strong>Budget Transfer</strong>&nbsp;- Per F.S. 129.06(2)(a), the BOCC-designated Budget Officer may authorize intradepartmental budget transfers provided that the total appropriation of the department is not changed.</p>
<p><strong>Budget Supplement</strong>&nbsp;- By approved Resolution and motion recorded in the minutes, the budget may be amended by the Board without public hearing/advertisement under F.S. 129.06 (a) through (e).</p>
<p><strong>Budget Amendment</strong>&nbsp;- All other amendments to the budget for purposes not specifically authorized in F.S. 129.06(2) (a) – (e) are required to be adopted by a Resolution of the Board in a properly advertised (at least 2 days, but not more than 5 days) public hearing.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-5" aria-controls="accord-1-5" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Capital Improvement Plan</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-5" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>OMB prepares the Five Year Capital Improvement Plan, which shows how much money the County plans to spend on major projects that improve or expand the County’s infrastructure, such as roads, parks, buildings, and utilities.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-6" aria-controls="accord-1-6" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Non Ad Valorem Assessment Roll</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-6" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>OMB maintains and certifies the list of properties that are subject to Non Ad Valorem assessments, which are charges for specific services or benefits that some residents or property owners receive, such as fire rescue, solid waste, household chemical, or municipal service benefits units (MSBU). OMB also facilitates the inclusion of Non Ad Valorem assessments for other taxing authorities that use the same method of collection, such as community development districts (CDD), common facility districts (CFD), and educational facility benefit districts (EFBD).</p>
</div></div></div><div class="accordion-list-item-container multi-accrodion"><div class="accordion-item-header"><a data-accordion-all-device="true" data-open="false" class="accordion-trigger contains-heading accordion-closed" role="button" data-accordion-use-cookie="true" data-accordion-body="#accord-1-7" aria-controls="accord-1-7" aria-expanded="false" tabindex="0"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><h3 class="item-text">Studies and Analysis</h3></a></div><div class="accordion-item-body multi-accordion-body clearfix rs_skip" id="accord-1-7" style="display: none;"><div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>OMB conducts studies for various County departments to help them improve their performance, efficiency, and effectiveness.</p>
</div></div></div></div></div>
<p><a href="https://www.osceola.org/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Budget-Documents" class="styled-button-calltoaction" target="_self">View OMB Budget Documents &amp; Reports</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.osceola.org/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Special-Assessments" class="styled-button-calltoaction" target="_self">View Special Assessments</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.osceola.org/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Budget-Frequently-Asked-Questions" class="styled-button-calltoaction" target="_self">View OMB Frequent Questions</a></p>
<p><a href="https://www.osceola.org/Government/County-Budget-and-Financial-Statements/Glossary" class="styled-button-calltoaction" target="_self">View OMB Glossary</a></p>

</div>
        
            <div class="department-container-dept-head clearfix">
                <h2>Department Head</h2>
                
                <h3>
                    <div class="contact-name">Matthew Fuhrer, Director of Management &amp; Budget</div>
                </h3>

<!-- Chatbot Popup HTML -->
<div id="popUpMessage" class="">
  <div class="popup-message">

    <div class="popup-content-div">
      <button class="popup-close" style="display: block;">✖</button>

    </div>

          <div class="popup-getstarted-button">Get Started</div>
        </div>
      </div>

  </div>
</div>
<!-- Floating Chatbot HTML -->
<div id="floatingChatBotDiv">
  <div class="chatbotDiv enter">
    <div class="chatButtonBG"></div>
    <div class="unread-counts active"></div>
    <div class="chat">
      <div class="cbheader" role="region" aria-label="Osceola AI Assistant">
        <span class="menu-header cbheader-icon"></span>
        <ul id="dropdown-content" class="menu-dropdown-options" style="display: none;">
            <li class="submenu">
                <ul class="cs-dropdown">
                    <li>
                        <a class="ConversationStyle" style="display:none;" id="convstyle">Select Conversation Style </a>
                        <div class="radio-optionbox" style="display:none;">
                            <div class="radio-container">
                                <p>
                                    <input type="radio" id="Creative" name="radio-group" style="">
                                    <label for="Creative">Creative</label>
                                </p>
                                <p>
                                    <input type="radio" id="Balanced" name="radio-group" style="">
                                    <label for="Balanced">Balanced</label>
                                </p>
                                <p>
                                    <input type="radio" id="Precise" name="radio-group" style="">
                                    <label for="Precise">Precise</label>
                                </p>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </li>
                    <li>
                      <a class="NewChat" id="NewChat">New Topic </a>
                    </li>
                    <li>
                      <div class="switch-theme" id="switch-theme">
                        <a class="switch-theme-label">Switch to dark theme </a>
                        <input type="checkbox" id="toggle-btn" style="">
                        <label class="toggle" for="toggle-btn"></label>
                      </div>
                    </li>
                </ul>
            </li>
        </ul>

        <div class="img-respnsv chat-updates cbheader-icon" alt="">
          <span class="offers-notification"></span>
        </div>
        <span class="title">Osceola AI Assistant</span>
        <span class="chat-close cbheader-icon" title="Close"></span>
        <span class="chat-minimize cbheader-icon"></span>
        <span id="chat-maximize" title="Maximize/Minimize" class="chat-maximize-expand cbheader-icon"></span>
        <span class="markStar cbheader-icon" alt="" style="display:none"></span>
        <span class="unmarkStar cbheader-icon" alt=""></span>
        <span lang-id="es" class="topbarLangBtn cbheader-icon" name="lang" title="Change language to Spanish"></span>
        <!-- <span class="settings cbheader-icon hidden" title="Settings"></span>
        <span class="resetChat cbheader-icon" title="Reset Chat"></span> -->
      </div>
      <div class="copyShareStarSearch"></div>

      <!-- Chatbot Loading Mask -->
      <div id="loadingBotSpinner" class="snippet" data-title="loading-mask" style="display: none;">
        <div class="loading-dots-wrapper">
          <div class="dot-pulse"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="loading-message" style="display: none;">Loading...</div>
      </div>

      <div id="floatingChatBody" class="floatingChatBody"></div>
      <div id="floatingUpdateBody" class="floatingUpdateBody"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
